name: Food Requirement Intake Prompts
purpose: Structured questions to capture hard food requirements, values, allergies, symptoms, labs and goals before generating diet guidance.

global_first_run_questions.question: Are there foods you never eat or must avoid?
Do you have confirmed or suspected food allergies?
Do you follow religious, cultural, ethical, or personal food rules?
Has a clinician told you to follow a specific diet?
What are you optimizing for right now?
Which recent labs do you have?

fish_yes_pork_no: Is pork avoidance strict enough to include gelatin, lard, pork broth, enzymes, or cross-contact?
Do you eat shellfish, or only fin fish?
Are you pregnant, trying to conceive, feeding children, or needing mercury limits?
Do you have histamine reactions to canned/smoked/fish leftovers?
allergy_or_atopy: Which foods cause immediate symptoms within minutes to hours?
Have you ever had swelling, wheezing, throat tightness, faintness, or needed epinephrine?
Was allergy confirmed by an allergist, IgE test, or food challenge?
histamine: Do symptoms worsen with wine/beer, aged cheese, cured meats, fermented foods, leftovers, canned fish, or vinegar?
Do fresh-cooked foods feel different than leftovers?
Do antihistamines or DAO enzymes change symptoms?
glucose_metabolic: Do you have A1c, fasting glucose, fasting insulin, or CGM data?
Do symptoms worsen after refined carbs or sugary drinks?
What protein/fiber intake is typical at breakfast?
pmdd_cycle: Are symptoms clearly worse in the luteal phase and relieved after menstruation starts?
Have symptoms been tracked daily across at least two cycles?
Do caffeine, alcohol, poor sleep, low meals, or high sugar worsen symptoms?
Do you have ferritin, B12/MMA, vitamin D, and thyroid labs?
muscle_gain: What is body weight, training volume, and current daily protein estimate?
Any kidney disease, high creatinine, or abnormal eGFR?
Any dairy/egg/fish/soy restrictions that affect protein options?
kidney_stone_or_gout: Was the stone type confirmed or uric acid measured?
Do beer, organ meats, sardines/anchovies, or high-fructose drinks trigger flares?
